speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning. I see you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise during your pregnancy. To begin our evaluation, have these symptoms been present for more than five days?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail. Given your pregnancy and recent ice cream consumption, were you recently in an area where milk products might have been unpasteurized? Additionally, have you noticed any rash or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (caused by Listeria monocytogenes). The combination of fever, headache, anorexia, and malaise in a third-trimester pregnant patient, following consumption of potentially unpasteurized dairy products three days prior, is classic for listeriosis. REQUEST TEST: Blood culture and Listeria serology.
